title: Hera Syndulla
description: Twi-lek Hera Syndulla rebelled against the Galactic Empire at a young age. With her father's friend, Gobi, she met the mercenaries called the Bad Batch. Hera befriended the Batch's young companion, Omega. When Imperials endangered her family, Hera asked the Bad Batch for help. During the rescue of her parents, Hera piloted a shuttle for the first time.
